title: Support says someone logged into an admin account without the password
brief: A customer support ticket says an attacker reached the admin dashboard without knowing any password. The login endpoint builds its query by hand.
hints: The problem is not which characters arrive. It is that the value becomes part of the statement at all.
Anything you filter, you also filter for real users. What would let the database tell code and data apart on its own?
Pass the SQL and the values to db.query() separately, using ? placeholders.
